sources.cohort: Base merchant-checkout escrow with on-chain fee terms; NOT agent API exchange volume
sources.evidence_basis: publisher chain-indexed and decoded payment-instruction analysis, not independently replayed by AgentMine
sources.merchant_count_note: 26 and 47 are per-tier counts; unique merchants cannot be determined by addition.
sources.fee_evidence_scope: Processor gross fees on a merchant checkout product, not AgentMine, not evidence that a generic x402 Agent Exchange can capture these fees or operate profitably.
sources.caveats: Bitquery's own research; chain/payment classifications and processor attribution are analytical inferences. Not independently audited by AgentMine. Refunded/voided/captured counts are source-reported and should not be assumed disjoint or summable without lifecycle definitions.

sources.cohort: Four vendor-operated x402 GPU placement attempts across three upstream providers; small non-identical jobs, not independent paying customers.
sources.caveats: Vendor-operated test, not independently confirmed provider fulfillment or production buyer retention. Different GPU configurations; no representative delivery rate or marketplace conversion can be inferred. Failed paid request was credited to platform account, not refunded as USDC to wallet.

sources.advertised_capability: Pre-payment endpoint probing, payment-envelope validation, reliability scoring and agent tools (nine free, six paid per call advertised).
sources.explicitly_unverified: Delivery after payment (publisher explicitly says it does not verify delivery-after-payment).
sources.implication: Generic pre-payment reliability scoring already has an incumbent; paid-but-undelivered outcome/recovery is a testable separate workflow problem, not a proven unoccupied market.

cross_source_inference.new_market_signal: A publisher-reported nonzero, on-chain fee-taking merchant checkout exists, and a separate vendor-operated x402 paid GPU test reported one paid-but-undelivered attempt. These are distinct products and cannot be added into a single demand estimate.
cross_source_inference.candidate_wedge: Post-payment delivery/recovery evidence and exception resolution, only if a lawful no-spend or opt-in paid pilot demonstrates incremental outcome versus existing vendors.
cross_source_inference.decision: Do not pivot or launch on this evidence alone. Preserve Phase 0 gates; investigate buyer need and unit economics for post-payment fulfillment before any new feature.
